role: independent historical-source audit; claim obligations, not semantic parser declarations

source.author: Ignoti Auctoris, not Thomas for these chapters
source.edition: Leonine Rome 1882, modern electronically served text; not collated medieval witness
source.scope: complete served page including II.10.6b, II.11.1-9, II.12.1-6 and apparatus

suppression.strongest_fair_account: Generic opposed-wind conditional: equal force produces mutual obstruction; unequal force lets the stronger eliminate the weaker active wind. A claimed survivor is the original stronger participant in the encounter, not an automatically generated successor.
requirements_if_claimed: original stronger identity distinguished from later generated participants
weaker cessation caused by stronger when incidence is asserted
counterexamples: weaker survives as outcome of the unequal-strength branch
opposed participants persistently blow jointly in the described confrontation
suppression alone automatically generates an adjacent successor
limits: conditional physics need not report an actual storm
survivor persistence is an implication, not an explicit individuated narrative
no permanent lifetime or unchanged properties of stronger
no destruction of an entire wind kind
non-opposed winds can jointly blow toward the same region from different source signs

succession_after_cessation.strongest_fair_account: A preceding wind ceases; a nearby wind is subsequently generated around the horizon. Solar approach raises dry exhalation and generates winds in new regions; withdrawal removes elevation and causes cessation.
requirements_if_claimed: distinction of generated participant from preceding participant
solar cause if solar gyration is asserted
counterexamples: continued unbroken first wind relabeled as successor
mere kind equality presented as generation
suppression or water collision required as the sole historical cause
one universal four-leg annual route imposed on observer-specific descriptions
limits: ordering but no exact interval or mandatory hiatus
no measured angle or constant speed
ground reflection and downward displacement belong to other source mechanisms

kind_or_relational.strongest_fair_account: Connected generic predicates and conditional physics about kinds, source relations, strength, generation and effects; neither names-only taxonomy nor empty tautology is required.
requirements_if_claimed: distinguish kinds, instances, properties and events
do not infer an actual event from a generic antecedent
retain ordering if succession is asserted
specify actual conditions and participants for an actual episode
do not infer physical participant identity from kind equality
counterexamples: generic rule treated as evidence its antecedent actually happened
kind equality used to identify a surviving physical participant
claimed succession with no preceding cessation or later generation
limits: can fairly express both suppression and succession conditionals
static explicit before/after states can express the same source obligations
source supplies no preference for state mutation over equivalent relational description

requirements: names identify origin bearings rather than destination bearings
local non-observation is not global nonexistence
proximity to northern observers is distinct from source strength and material abundance
annual sequence descriptions vary by observer context
shared_controls.does_not_supply: manuscript diagram orientation, source ownership, cardinal names or universal route

requirements: distinguish diametrical place opposition from opposition in both qualities
retain participative intermediate opposition and local visibility qualifications
shared_controls.counterexample: a silently repaired unique name-quality table treated as the source's sole uniform system

requirements: opposed winds can have the same effect accidentally
intrinsic opposition does not prohibit common observed effects
cold-driven condensation and force-driven clearing can coexist
very cold winds need not clear the sky
humidity mixing can change a wind's final effect
distinguish cloud outflow from vertical displacement by another wind

fair_combination_condition: Every claimed transition, participant, condition and causal mechanism must be specified; historical coexistence alone does not supply missing manuscript content.
claim_ceiling: Historical content prior only; zero confirmed manuscript translations. Named winds, cardinal axes, intermediate winds and solar cycles exist in the source without thereby identifying manuscript entities.
